newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Francisco Redevelopment.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
City and County of San Francisco
Redevelopment Financing Authority
1996 Series B Tax Allocation Revenue Bonds
(San Francisco Redevelopment Projects)
City and County of San Francisco
Redevelopment Financing Authority
1996 Series C Taxable Tax Allocation Revenue Bonds
(San Francisco Redevelopment Projects)
City and County of San Francisco
Redevelopment Financing Authority
1996 Series D Tax Allocation Revenue Refunding Bonds
(San Francisco Redevelopment Projects)
The City and County of San Francisco Redevelopment

Financing Authority (the Authority'') intends to receive sealed bids for its 1996 Series B Tax Allocation Revenue Bonds (San Francisco Redevelopment Projects), 1996 Series C Taxable Tax Allocation Revenue Bonds (San Francisco
Redevelopment Projects) and 1996 Series D Tax Allocation Revenue Refunding Bonds (San Francisco Redevelopment
Projects) (the ''Bonds'' 0 a.m., San Francisco time, on
Wednesday, January 8, 1997

at the Redevelopment Agency of the City and County of San Francisco, 770 Golden Gate Avenue, 3rd Floor, San Francisco, California 94102, for the above-captioned Bonds. The Bonds mature and are subject to redemption as described in the Notice Inviting Bids. The Authority reserves the right to postpone, from time to time, the date established for the receipt of sealed bids (without further advertising) to any given future dates selected by the Authority, so long as notice is given through Munifacts prior to such selected date(s) as more fully described under the paragraph

POSTPONEMENT'' in the Notice Inviting Bids. Mailed bids should be addressed to the Authority in care of Robert T. Gamble, Treasurer, c/o Redevelopment Agency of the City and County of San Francisco, 770 Golden Gate Avenue, 3rd Floor, San Francisco, California 94102. Bids will be accepted, opened and awarded by the Authority. All bids must be clearly marked
Proposal f
f the City and County of San Francisco Redevelopment Financing Authority 1996 Series B Tax Allocation Revenue Bonds Series C Taxable Tax Allocation Revenue Bonds Series D Tax
Allocation Revenue Refunding Bonds (or any combination thereof, as applicable) ''.

Copies of the complete Notice Inviting Bids, together with copies of the Official Statement relating to the Bonds and copies of the Indenture and Loan Agreement(s) related thereto, may be obtained from the offices of the Authority's Financial Advisor: Stephens, McCarthy, Kuenzel & Caldwell,
Ltd. 1736 Stockton Street, Suite 1, San Francisco, CA 9 Telephone (415) 912-5615.
Given by order of the City and County of San Francisco Redevelopment Financing Authority.
*Preliminary, subject to change.
(From The Bond Buyer)
